notes: 2018_00_link.txt is the HR Pregnancy/Parental Leave page; 2018_01_fmla_ofla.txt is the HR FMLA/OFLA page; 2018_02_aaup_cba_2015_2019_amended_2017_06.txt holds post-tenure review procedures only, despite the file name; 2018_03_aaup_cba_2015_2019_amended_2016_09.txt is the full agreement; 2018_04_aaup_cba_2015_2019_signed.txt is a copy of 2018_03. The scanned MOU pages of 2018_03 (PDF pp. 102-105, no text layer) hold the MOU of July 27, 2016 revising Art. 32 Sec. 2(b) and (f) (enrolment and donation mechanics of the Sick Leave Bank; use terms in 2(e) unchanged) and the MOU of Sept 9, 2016 replacing Appendix E2 (NTT position description). 2018_05 (sabbatical MOU) has no text.

Governing document: the PSU-AAUP collective agreement (2015-2019, effective April 5, 2016; in force on 2018-02-17) covers tenure-related faculty. Its only family-leave article (Art. 32) commits the University to the state and federal statutes (FMLA, OFLA), sets notice, a tenure-clock exclusion for family or medical leave time, a discretionary/negotiated tenure extension of up to one year, and the Donated Sick Leave Bank. It grants no paid parental leave, no modified duties and no teaching relief. The HR pages summarise FMLA/OFLA pregnancy-disability and parental leave and say pay comes only from accrued leave.

Birth parent chain: OFLA pregnancy-disability leave (6 weeks, 8 cesarean, up to 12 with pre-birth incapacity) → OFLA parental leave 12 weeks (S1a: 'In addition to'); FMLA 12 workweeks alongside from the start; pay only from own accrued sick leave (within FMLA) → Sick Leave Bank up to 60 work days for participants → short-term disability for those covered, after a one-week wait (no stated length). No employer-paid leave.

Non-birth parent chain: OFLA family leave 12 weeks (bonding, or care of the spouse during pregnancy disability) with FMLA 12 workweeks alongside; pay only from own accrued leave → Sick Leave Bank (paternity leave) for participants. No employer-paid leave.

S1a conflict (flagged on c2): rule S1a's example reads 'Portland State OFLA parental leave left concurrent (text silent on adding)', but the saved ORS 659A.162(3)(a) (2017 edition) says 'In addition to the 12 weeks of family leave ... a female eligible employee may take a total of 12 weeks of leave ... related to pregnancy or childbirth'. The rule's own text covers additions made by 'the statute or the institution's text'; I followed the rule text and coded c2 consecutive_after c3 for the birth parent. If the example governs, change that entry to concurrent_with.

Not components: sabbatical leave (Art. 33; study and research), career development leave without pay (Art. 17, Appendix F note 3), voluntary leaves of absence in retrenchment (Art. 22), temporary reassignment when an office presents a clear health or safety danger (Art. 24 Sec. 4; not pregnancy-specific), the PDP extension 'due to sabbatical or other approved leave' (PTR procedures IX.A.2; only after an unsatisfactory review), and personal circumstances such as maternity, paternity or adoption as a factor in post-tenure review (VI.C.2.iv.d). LOA #4 sets up a Work/Life Balance committee; no provision.

Calendar: the agreement describes a three-term academic year ('one-term', 'two-term' and 'three-term (one academic year)' sabbaticals; fall, winter and Summer terms): quarters; calendar.kind = quarter, and the term length follows R8's order. No component is measured in terms.

Documents cited but not saved: PSU Policy and Procedures for the Evaluation of Faculty for Tenure, Promotions, and Merit Increases (1996, rev. 2014-04-07); University standards on sick time (former OAR 580-021-0040); University policy on unearned sick leave advance; short-term and long-term disability insurance plans; OAR 580-021-0029 career development leave; Work/Life Policy (Aug 10, 2001); GSE Doctoral Faculty Workload Release Policy (Jan 21, 2015); HR pages linked from the saved pages (leave process page, Employee FMLA/OFLA Q&A, Medical Leave, Personal Leave, Sick Leave, Vacation & Personal Days, Optional Benefits); later MOUs to the 2018_03 agreement (Nov 2016 paid administrative leave, Dec 2016 sabbatical, etc.).

Reference date 2018-02-17. The agreement's term (Dec 1, 2015 - Nov 30, 2019) covers it; the HR pages are undated 2018 captures accepted under the reference-period rule (2017-18). No provision is flagged not_yet_effective.
